new.name: IDENTIFIES_UNDERSPECIFIED_REQUIREMENT
new.definition: The reasoning detects an ambiguity, gap, or unstated edge case in the given requirements, weighs competing interpretations or their risks, and commits to one interpretation before implementing.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that flags the ambiguity and settles on an interpretation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning names a specific requirement that is ambiguous or underspecified.
The reasoning considers at least two candidate interpretations or explicitly weighs the risk of each option.
The reasoning commits to a chosen interpretation that later implementation follows.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely paraphrases the requirements without identifying any ambiguity or gap.
An ambiguity is mentioned but no interpretation is chosen and no alternatives are weighed.
The reasoning describes a decision that is fully determined by explicit requirements.

new.name: DIAGNOSES_FAILURE_CAUSE
new.definition: The reasoning explains why an observed failure or error occurred by naming a specific cause, rather than merely restating that the failure happened.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning containing the causal explanation.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the failure or error being explained.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports an error, rejection, or failed outcome.
The reasoning names a specific cause for that failure.
The causal attribution is connected to the content of the observation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only repeats the error message or notes that something failed without explaining why.
The reasoning attributes the failure to a cause that is not supported by the observation.
No failure is reported in the corresponding observation.

new.name: RETRIES_WITH_CORRECTED_ACTION
new.definition: After a failed attempt, the reasoning identifies a correctable defect in that attempt, and a subsequent action repeats the same operation with the defect corrected.

parameters.name: failed_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the failure of the prior attempt.

parameters.name: corrective_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning naming the defect and the intended correction.

parameters.name: retry_action
parameters.description: The action repeating the operation with the correction applied.

assertion_conditions: The observation shows that the preceding attempt failed.
The reasoning identifies the specific defect to be fixed and indicates the operation will be attempted again.
The retry action performs the same operation with the identified defect corrected.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning abandons the operation instead of correcting and repeating it.
The retry action does not address the defect named in the reasoning.
No prior failure is present in the trajectory.

new.name: REPLACES_UNAVAILABLE_MEANS
new.definition: An observation shows that a preferred tool or capability is unavailable, and the reasoning selects a functionally different means to accomplish the same goal, which the subsequent action then performs.

parameters.name: unavailability_observation
parameters.description: The observation showing that the preferred tool or capability cannot be used.

parameters.name: substitution_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the substitution and its equivalent purpose.

parameters.name: alternative_action
parameters.description: The action carrying out the substituted means.

assertion_conditions: The observation shows a tool or capability is absent or nonfunctional.
The reasoning states that the preferred means cannot be used and names an alternative means for the same purpose.
The alternative action implements that alternative means.
exclusion_conditions: The failure stems from malformed arguments or inputs rather than an unavailable capability.
The subsequent action reuses the same unavailable tool.
The alternative does not serve the same goal as the original means.

new.name: CONFIRMS_REQUIREMENTS_SATISFIED
new.definition: The reasoning concludes that specified requirements have been satisfied, resting that conclusion on the collective evidence of one or more observations of executed checks whose results matched expectations.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning drawing the satisfaction conclusion from the collected results.

parameters.name: observations
parameters.description: The observations of executed checks that jointly support the conclusion; support is collective, not alternative.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning refers to outcomes of executed checks and compares them with expected behavior.
The reasoning explicitly concludes that the required behavior has been met.
Each cited observation contributes a result that the conclusion depends on.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only lists raw results without drawing a satisfaction conclusion.
The satisfaction conclusion is asserted with no supporting observed result.
A cited check produced a failing or contradictory result that the reasoning leaves unresolved.
